Usage Notes

About This Color System

  • Adaptive Design: All colors automatically adapt between light and dark modes using CSS custom properties.
  • Semantic Naming: Colors are named by their purpose (primary, secondary, success) rather than their appearance (blue, red).
  • Color-mix Technology: Most colors are derived from base colors using the CSS color-mix() function for consistency.
  • OKLCH Color Space: Colors use OKLCH for better perceptual uniformity and color manipulation.
  • Neon Accent System: Vibrant neon colors provide the foundation for bright color palette.

tokens.--color-accent-active: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(calc(38 * 1%) 0.2 245) calc(l + 0.28) c calc(h - 18)) calc(l - 0.16) calc(c * 0.78) h)
tokens.--color-accent-hover: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(calc(38 * 1%) 0.2 245) calc(l + 0.28) c calc(h - 18)) calc(l + 0.02) calc(c * 0.85) h)
tokens.--color-border-disabled: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(90% 0.02 200) calc(l - 0.13) c h) calc(l + 0.06) c h)
tokens.--color-error-soft: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(70% 0.3 15) 0.68 calc(c * 0.82) h) l c h / 0.25)
tokens.--color-info-soft: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(88% 0.15 202) 0.68 calc(c * 0.82) h) l c h / 0.30)
tokens.--color-shadow-surface-base: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(25% 0.02 200) calc(l + 0.75) c h) l calc(0.2 * 0.05) 245)
tokens.--color-success-soft: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(88% 0.25 148) 0.68 calc(c * 0.82) h) l c h / 0.25)
tokens.--color-surface-active: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(90% 0.02 200) calc(l + 0.08) calc(0.02 * 0.25) h) calc(l - 0.1) c h)
tokens.--color-surface-disabled: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(90% 0.02 200) calc(l + 0.08) calc(0.02 * 0.25) h) calc(l - 0.2) c h)
tokens.--color-surface-hover: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(90% 0.02 200) calc(l + 0.08) calc(0.02 * 0.25) h) calc(l - 0.05) c h)
tokens.--color-surface-secondary: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(90% 0.02 200) calc(l + 0.08) calc(0.02 * 0.25) h) calc(l - 0.03) c h)

tokens.--inset-shadow-highlight-pressed: inset 0 1px oklch(from oklch(calc(38 * 1%) 0.2 245) l c h / 0.15)
tokens.--inset-shadow-pressed: inset 0 1px 2px oklch(from oklch(from oklch(25% 0.02 200) l c calc(h * 0.9 + 245 * 0.1)) l c h / 0.1)
tokens.--shadow-drop: 0 1px 2px oklch(from oklch(from oklch(25% 0.02 200) l c calc(h * 0.9 + 245 * 0.1)) l c h / 0.2)
tokens.--shadow-drop-subtle: 0 1px 1px oklch(from oklch(from oklch(25% 0.02 200) l c calc(h * 0.9 + 245 * 0.1)) l c h / 0.1)
